data.reason: Slice 2 (commit 1705577, RED 92, GREEN 93) makes report._mutation say not applicable only when not_applicable is true. harness/tests/test_report.py MutationColumnTest.test_a_measurement_with_no_mutants_says_so_rather_than_a_hundred now fails (record 94): its fixture is a no-mutants measurement without not_applicable=True, a shape no real record has (mutation.py:229 always sets it). The fix is one fixture line in test_report.py, which no slice names, so the triage's slice_files check would refuse it. Ruud decided to amend the plan rather than drop the report half of F3: slice 2 gains harness/tests/test_report.py, and its report tests (MutationCellTest, placed in test_kpi.py because test_report.py was not a slice file) move there beside MutationColumnTest. Slice 1 (RED 82, GREEN 87, regression 88) is unaffected.
